title: Frieren Songpack - Moonlight Edition
description: This is a songpack for the mod Reactive Music by CircuitLord that adds a large variety of music from the show Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
body:
# Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Songpack - Moonlight Edition
I got inspired by another songpack creator named ethan (huzzfumbler67), who created a similar songpack for the Frieren: Beyond Journey's End soundtrack, but I wanted to make my own since I though it could use some more music, and well, here it is!

This is for use with the [Reactive Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/reactive-music) mod.

This features almost 50 different songs from Season 1 of the show, composed by Evan Call and owned by Aniplex/Madhouse. I do not own any of the music in this creation and this was created not for profit. Do not re-release this for profit.

# Music
